problems.quote: Article 371D (Andhra Pradesh) and 371E (Telangana) guarantee equitable opportunities in public employment and education through local cadres and a Central University respectively.
problems.problem: Article 371E is not a provision for Telangana; it provides for a Central University in Andhra Pradesh.
problems.correction: Article 371D (Andhra Pradesh) provides for equitable opportunities in public employment and education through local cadres, while Article 371E provides for a Central University in Andhra Pradesh.
problems.verifierReason: Art. 371E provides for Central Univ. in Andhra Pradesh, not Telangana. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: Article 371I (Goa) fixes the Legislative Assembly at 40 members.
problems.problem: Article 371I sets a minimum of 30 members, not a fixed strength of 40.
problems.correction: Article 371I (Goa) provides for a Legislative Assembly of not less than 30 members.
problems.verifierReason: Art. 371I sets minimum 30 members, not fixed 40. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: In State of Bombay v. F. N. Balsara (1951) , the Court applied eclipse to a pre‑1950 prohibition law after the 1st Amendment inserted Article 19(6).
problems.problem: The doctrine of eclipse was first articulated in Bhikaji Narain Dhakras v. State of Madhya Pradesh (1955), not in Balsara (1951).
problems.correction: In Bhikaji Narain Dhakras v. State of Madhya Pradesh (1955), the Court applied eclipse to a pre‑1950 law after the 1st Amendment inserted Article 19(6).
problems.verifierReason: Eclipse doctrine first in Bhikaji (1955), not Balsara (1951). Correction accurate.
